title: Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)

entities.name: Event A3
entities.description: Measurement event triggered when a neighbour cell becomes offset better than the serving cell (SpCell).

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs measurements and triggers Event A3 when conditions are met.

entities.name: Neighbour Cell
entities.description: Adjacent cell measured by the UE for comparison with the serving cell.

entities.name: Serving Cell
entities.description: The primary serving cell (SpCell) used as reference for measurement comparisons.

relations.description: UE triggers Event A3 when measurement conditions are satisfied.
Event A3 condition involves comparing neighbour cell quality with serving cell.
Event A3 uses serving cell (SpCell) as the reference for measurement comparison.
